commitResults.messageTitle: Add file storage for task list persistence
commitResults.messageBody:
Save tasks to './data/oz.txt' automatically whenever the task list
is modified (on adding, marking, unmarking, or deleting tasks).

Load existing tasks from the storage file on chatbot startup, with
graceful handling for missing files and malformed task records.

Update .gitignore to exclude runtime storage data.

commitResults.messageTitle: Support date and time parsing for tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
Parse deadline and event dates into java.time objects using
TaskDateTime, supporting formats such as yyyy-MM-dd and d/M/yyyy HHmm.

Display dates formatted as 'MMM dd yyyy' and 'MMM dd yyyy, h:mma'
while persisting standard representations to disk.

commitResults.messageTitle: Support time for events and add input validation
commitResults.messageBody:
Allow events and deadlines to accept time components in addition to
dates in TaskDateTime, supporting formats such as 1800 and 6pm.

Validate that an event's start date/time is not after its end date/time
in Event and ensure task descriptions and date arguments are non-empty
in Oz.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add 'on' command to filter tasks by date
commitResults.messageBody:
Implement the 'on <date>' command to find and list all deadlines and
events occurring on a specific date.

Add occursOn method to Task, Deadlines, and Event to check date
matching and interval overlap.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract Storage class for task persistence
commitResults.messageBody:
Extract file reading, writing, and parsing logic from Oz into a
dedicated Storage class.

Oz now instantiates Storage with the storage file path and delegates
task loading and saving operations to it.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract TaskList class to manage tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
Encapsulate task list collection and mutation operations in a
dedicated TaskList class.

Update Storage and Oz to use TaskList rather than interacting directly
with raw ArrayList collections.

commitResults.messageTitle: Organize classes into packages under src/main/java
commitResults.messageBody:
Move classes into dedicated packages under src/main/java/oz/ to
improve modularity and maintainability.

Group classes into oz, oz.exception, oz.storage, and oz.task packages,
updating package declarations and imports accordingly.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for TaskDateTime and TaskList
commitResults.messageBody:
Add JUnit 5 test classes TaskDateTimeTest and TaskListTest under
src/test/java/oz/task/ following Gradle conventions.

Cover valid date/time parsing variations, error handling for invalid
or empty inputs, date comparisons, and task list mutations.

commitResults.messageTitle: Expand JUnit test suites and document 50% coverage
commitResults.messageBody:
Add comprehensive test suites for Event and Deadlines, and extend
test cases for TaskDateTime and TaskList to target top-value methods.

Update AGENTS.md to document the 50% test coverage requirement.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add comprehensive Javadoc comments across codebase
commitResults.messageBody:
Add Javadoc header comments to all classes, constructors, methods,
and fields across the project.

Verify full Javadoc generation via Gradle with zero warnings.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add seedu-java-coding-standard skill and refactor code
commitResults.messageBody:
Create seedu-java-coding-standard skill in .agents/skills/ based on
SE-EDU Java Coding Standard (Basic + Intermediate) guidelines.

Mandate coding standard in AGENTS.md and refactor variable names
and argument patterns to eliminate abbreviations and single letters.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add seedu-git-standard skill and update AGENTS.md
commitResults.messageBody:
The repository lacks a dedicated project skill for SE-EDU Git
conventions, and AGENTS.md does not mandate commit message structure.

Inconsistent commit formatting makes it difficult for reviewers to
quickly understand the rationale behind changes.

Let's create the seedu-git-standard skill under .agents/skills/ and
update AGENTS.md to mandate adherence to SE-EDU Git conventions.

Defining a dedicated skill and linking it in AGENTS.md ensures all
future commits consistently follow structured commit message standards.

Refer to SE-EDU Git conventions:
https://se-education.org/guides/conventions/git.html

commitResults.messageTitle: Add find command to search tasks by keyword
commitResults.messageBody:
Users can view, add, and query tasks by date, but cannot search
tasks matching a specific keyword.

Manually scanning the entire task list to locate specific tasks is
cumbersome when the list grows large.

Let's introduce a find command to search and list all tasks whose
descriptions match a given keyword case-insensitively.

Adding containsKeyword to Task and findTasksByKeyword to TaskList
encapsulates search logic in the task domain layer.

Unit tests in TaskListTest cover matching, non-matching, and
case-insensitive search scenarios.
